caption:
AMD just launched the Ryzen AI Halo, a mini-PC for AI development priced at $3,999.99. It features the powerful Zen 5 Ryzen AI Max+ 395 processor, equipped with integrated Radeon 8060S graphics. This system is designed to streamline AI learning with robust memory and storage capabilities.
